Added the four gross fund-column transfer lines. After the fix the governmental transfers-in detail is 25,000 + 89,541 = 114,541 vs statement Total 114,000: the remaining -541 is only the Adjustments column netting the governmental interfund transfers (536 + 5 = 541) = different basis, not an error; the transfers-out lines (541 vs Total 0) are the same netting. Also added the business-type 'Transfers' cell of the proprietary statement p15 (Electric Fund (114,000) = the governmental net transfers in) so the utility fund columns are complete; it is business-type and does not count in this governmental row.

gaps.explanation: The business-type detail lines are the four Business-Type Activities rows of the Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Cash Basis - Total Primary Government (cash budgetary basis): Electric 852,052 + Solid Waste 106,443 + Sewer 180,110 + Water 134,457 = 1,273,062 (detail indexes 22-25). They are the same funds' spending on another basis, while the proprietary fund columns the statement uses are not in detail. Statement: Total Operating Expenses 1,205,156 (p14) + Interest Expense 10,795 (p15) = 1,215,951. Fix: remove the four budget lines and add one line per printed non-zero cell of the proprietary statement fund columns: Electric 95,390 + 425,759 + 78,096 + 122,725 + 32,610 = 754,580 + interest 895; Water 68,423 + 5,075 + 11,980 + 42,838 + 5,630 = 133,946; Sewer 70,198 + 2,300 + 7,938 + 33,064 + 96,471 = 209,971 + interest 9,900; Sanitation Contracted Services 106,659. Added 754,580 + 895 + 133,946 + 209,971 + 9,900 + 106,659 = 1,215,951. Check: 1,273,062 + 1,215,951 - 1,273,062 = 1,215,951 = statement (gap 0).
